heads.la: IV. Sermo inlustrissimi doctoris sancti Augustini, de resurrectione Domini nostri Jhesu Christi dedicatus.
heads.en: IV. A sermon of the most illustrious doctor Saint Augustine, dedicated to the resurrection of our Lord Jesus Christ.

headnotes.la: … *Ut in nomine Domini omne genu flectatur coelestium et terrestrium et infernorum.* Mox ergo captivae animae, de custodiis relaxatae tartareis, proruunt, regi saeculorum moesta supplicatione deplorant
headnotes.en: …ings on earth and things beneath the earth.* Soon, then, the captive souls, released from their Tartarean prisons, rush forth, and with sorrowful supplication make their lament to the King of the ages
